tasks.short: Conduct the research and publish the findings herself.

steps.what: Conduct research in this particular field of knowledge before writing
Write the findings the professional article will carry
Arrange to publish that text in professional journals, books, or electronic media

tasks.design: She still conducts the research in this field, writes the findings, and arranges publication in a journal, a book, or electronic media. The findings are the research, so no composition step is handed off. No second entry is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The findings are her research. A summary of other people's papers is not that article.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing now writes the findings for her.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong finding in a journal is her name on it.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what the finding is and whether it is ready to publish.
tasks.altitude: The week is unchanged. She still conducts the research and still publishes the findings.

reach.task: Point to the journal that fits the article

evidence.claim: She conducts the research and writes the findings herself before they are published.

assumptions: She still conducts the research, writes the findings, and arranges publication. No step of that work is removed, so the saving is zero.
No second entry of the article is removed, and no extra upkeep is added. The upkeep hours are zero.
Shares are the time those acts take on a normal article, not the time-share buckets.
unknowns: Whether a co-author writes the findings on some papers.
research_questions: On which papers does she write every finding herself?

already_counted.description: The research, the findings, and the publication stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: No new upkeep. The hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still conducts the research, writes the findings, and arranges publication, so nothing is removed and the saving is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve as department head in the staffing meeting.

steps.what: Hear the staffing gap a colleague brings to the department meeting
Tell that colleague how teaching cover will be set
Perform administrative duties while serving as department head this week

tasks.design: She still hears the staffing gap in the department meeting, tells the colleague how teaching cover will be set, and performs the administrative duties of serving as department head. No note replaces that conversation, and nothing is filed a second time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Directing the department is a conversation with colleagues. A stored list of duties is not that direction.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing now directs the department for her.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong cover decision leaves a class without a teacher, and the colleagues still need her word.
tasks.human_edge: She decides the cover and she tells the colleague.
tasks.altitude: The week is unchanged. She still chairs the department meeting and still tells the colleague.

reach.task: Bring the staffing gap to the department meeting
reach.learn: Which class needs cover this week

evidence.claim: Serving as department head is directing people in the meeting.

assumptions: She still hears the gap, tells the colleague, and performs the administrative duties. No step of that work is removed, so the saving is zero.
Telling a colleague is not a send outside the organisation, and no extra upkeep is added. The upkeep hours are zero.
Shares are the time those acts take in a normal week, not the time-share buckets.
unknowns: Whether a department secretary already records the cover decision.
research_questions: Which administrative duties does she still do herself while serving as department head?

already_counted.description: Hearing the gap, telling the colleague, and the week's duties stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: No new upkeep. The hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The department meeting and the duties of serving as department head stay hers, so the saving is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write the grant proposal and submit the accepted text.

steps.what: Read the call and list every criterion the proposal must answer
List publications, budget amounts, and partners the proposal may name
Write grant proposals as paragraphs from those criteria and publications

loop.input: the call criteria she listed and the publication titles she listed
loop.check: a sentence states a finding that is not one of those publications, or it states an amount or a partner, or it answers a criterion she did not list
loop.stop: no such sentence remains, or the paragraph count reaches the call's page limit, and then she reviews
loop.why_not_simpler: a keyword check cannot tell a published finding from one she never wrote

steps.what: Reject a paragraph that states a finding, amount, or partner she did not list
Submit the accepted text to procure external research funding

tasks.design: She still reads the call and lists the criteria, the publication titles, the budget amounts, and the partners. A draft in {DOCS} writes the proposal paragraphs from the criteria and the publication titles only, and it must not state an amount or a partner. She rejects a paragraph that does, then she submits the text she accepted. The work removed is writing those paragraphs, which she does today.
tasks.previous_blocker: The proposal narrative is her account of the work, and a pasted draft in an outside chat would breach confidentiality.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft inside {DOCS} can restate criteria and publication titles she has already listed, and she still submits.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong finding or a named partner in a submitted proposal is her name on it, and some funders forbid a generated draft.
tasks.human_edge: She decides which publications may be named and she submits the text she accepted.
tasks.altitude: She still chooses the call and still submits. The first public paragraphs are a draft she can reject.

reach.learn: Which headings the draft must land under

reach.task: Confirm a partner may be named
reach.learn: Which partner stays off the draft

evidence.claim: She writes the grant narrative herself before the proposal is submitted.
Uploading a proposal breaches confidentiality, and referees may not use generative AI.
Drafting materials is not covered by the high-risk rules for grading and proctoring.

assumptions: The 22 points are the paragraphs she writes today. Only that composition is removed. She still reads the call, lists publications and amounts and partners, rejects a bad paragraph, and submits.
Shares are the time those acts take on a normal proposal, not the time-share buckets.
She produces the call criteria in s1 and the publication list in s2 before any paragraph is composed. If a list is missing she writes the paragraphs herself.
The draft uses only the call text and the publication titles she typed. It does not state budget amounts or partner names.
She does not paste the proposal into an outside chat. Uploading the proposal to an outside tool would breach confidentiality, so that path is not used.
Submitting is the same send she does today, so it is not removed work. Nothing is filed a second time.
If a research officer already writes the narrative, the saving does not apply.
Her extra upkeep is one hour per 100 for field names, not the per-case list. The research officer's hour is not her baseline.
unknowns: Whether a research officer already writes the narrative on her calls.
Whether this funder forbids a generated draft.
research_questions: Which calls are short enough that she still writes every paragraph?
Does a research officer write the narrative before she sees it?

already_counted.description: Reading the call, listing the facts, rejecting a bad paragraph, and submitting stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: She adds a publication title when a heading does not match the call.
A research officer keeps the call's section names.

approvals.approved_version: the proposal text she accepted in s4, including any paragraph she rewrote there

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If a research officer already writes the narrative, or the call is short and she still writes or edits every paragraph herself, the low is zero. A failed check still sends some proposals back to her pen, so the high stays at twelve, under the net after the one hour of field upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give consulting advice to government or industry.

steps.what: Hear the question government or industry brought to this consulting meeting
Provide professional consulting services as spoken advice on that question
Name the limit of what government or industry should change

tasks.design: She still hears the question government or industry brought, gives the professional consulting advice in the meeting, and names the limit of what they should change. The advice is spoken. No written deliverable is added, and no step of that meeting is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The consulting service is the advice she gives in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing now gives that advice for her.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong limit named to government or industry is her responsibility.
tasks.human_edge: She decides the advice and she says it.
tasks.altitude: The week is unchanged. She still gives the consulting advice in the meeting.

reach.task: State the decision government or industry must make this month
reach.learn: Which question the meeting is about

evidence.claim: The consulting service is the advice she gives in the meeting.

assumptions: She still hears the question, gives the spoken advice, and names the limit. No step of that meeting is removed, so the saving is zero.
The advice is spoken and is not a versioned send, and no extra upkeep is added. The upkeep hours are zero.
Shares are the time those acts take in a normal consulting meeting, not the time-share buckets.
unknowns: Whether some clients also expect a written note after the meeting.
research_questions: On which visits is the whole service the spoken advice?

already_counted.description: Hearing the question, giving the advice, and naming the limit stay in her remaining time.

incremental.description: No new upkeep. The hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The consulting meeting stays hers, so nothing is removed and the saving is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Research, the department meeting, and the consulting advice stay hers. The week only loses the first public paragraphs of a grant proposal.
reach: A research officer can keep the call's section names so the proposal draft lands under the printed headings.
A co-applicant can confirm a partner name before it is written into the proposal.
skills_to_grow: Reject a proposal sentence that cites a result she did not publish.
Keep an unnamed partner out of the draft.
role.ambitious_version: She still publishes her own findings, still chairs the department, and still gives the advice. Grant calls she chooses still go out under her name, with the first public paragraphs prepared for her check.
